abstract.t: This document specifies Hamming Quasi-Cyclic (HQC)-based ciphersuites for use with COSE-HPKE. It defines fully specified COSE algorithms for HPKE Integrated Encryption and HPKE Key Encryption, using HQC or PQ/T hybrid HQC key encapsulation, SHAKE256 key derivation, and AES- 256-GCM authenticated encryption. It specifies their AKP key representation and requests twelve COSE algorithm registrations. Message processing and context binding are inherited from COSE-HPKE.
